annotations.text:
A — Broadsheet
Editorial front-page hierarchy: the day reads like a newspaper, with a lead story, standfirst, and a ticker strip.
Tradeoff: the most layout to maintain, and the 3-column grid needs real thought on mobile.

B — Terminal
Data-first: price tiles with sparklines and the 5-year crack chart are the hero; stories become a dense scannable feed.
Tradeoff: heavier feel; the editorial voice (intro, overview) gets less room.

C — Newsletter
The email as the website: one warm reading column, zero learning curve from the daily brief, sign-off included.
Tradeoff: lowest information density; dashboard data lives on other pages.
